entities.summary: Kim Keum Hee is a South Korean writer. She made her literary debut in 2009 when her short story “Neoui dokyumeonteu” won the Korea Times New Writer's Contest. She published her first short story collection Sentimenteoldo haruiteul in 2014. The book won the 33rd Sin Dong-yup Prize for Literature. Her short story "Jo Junggyuneui segye" received the 6th Munhakdongne Young Writers' Award in 2015. She won the same award in 2016 and 2017 for “Neomu hannajeui yeonae” and “Munsang”, respectively. Her 2016 win was for the Grand Prize.
